title: Nature Days Out and National Parks for Families
description: Nature days out with kids: UK national parks, the Giant’s Causeway, Eden Project, Kew, US national parks, stargazing and geocaching. Many are free.
h1: Nature days out and national parks
intro: Mountains, waterfalls, forests and starry skies. The great outdoors is the best-value day out there is, and kids sleep brilliantly afterwards.

image.alt: A family walking together on a grassy hill

blocks.title: Scout’s nature verdict
blocks.text: Pick a short trail with a “wow” at the end: a waterfall, a view, a beach or an ice cream. Kids walk further for a reward.

sections.html: Try geocaching, stargazing, wildlife watching or a first family camping trip. In the US, see national parks with kids.

faqs.q: Are UK national parks free to visit?
faqs.a: Yes. There’s no entry fee to the UK’s national parks, though car parks and some attractions inside them charge.

cardText: National parks, gardens, coasts and starry skies.
